<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: right; margin: 0"><B>Exhibit&nbsp;10.3</B></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>FORM&nbsp;OF AMENDED AND RESTATED LIMITED PARTNERSHIP
AGREEMENT</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>OF</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>ANGEL OAK RESIDENTIAL EVERGREEN OPERATING PARTNERSHIP
L.P.,</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center"><B>A DELAWARE LIMITED PARTNERSHIP</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center"><B>[<FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT>],
2026</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">THE PARTNERSHIP INTERESTS OF ANGEL OAK RESIDENTIAL
EVERGREEN OPERATING PARTNERSHIP L.P. HAVE NOT BEEN REGISTERED UNDER THE UNITED STATES SECURITIES ACT OF 1933, AS AMENDED (THE &ldquo;SECURITIES
ACT&rdquo;), THE SECURITIES LAWS OF ANY STATE OF THE UNITED STATES OR ANY OTHER APPLICABLE SECURITIES LAWS IN RELIANCE UPON EXEMPTIONS
FROM THE REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS OF THE SECURITIES ACT AND SUCH LAWS. SUCH PARTNERSHIP INTERESTS MAY&nbsp;BE ACQUIRED FOR INVESTMENT
ONLY, AND NEITHER SUCH INTERESTS NOR ANY PART&nbsp;THEREOF MAY&nbsp;BE OFFERED FOR SALE, PLEDGED, HYPOTHECATED, SOLD, ASSIGNED OR TRANSFERRED
AT ANY TIME EXCEPT IN COMPLIANCE WITH (I)&nbsp;THE SECURITIES ACT, ANY APPLICABLE UNITED STATES STATE SECURITIES LAWS, AND ANY OTHER
APPLICABLE SECURITIES LAWS; (II)&nbsp;THE TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF THIS AMENDED AND RESTATED LIMITED PARTNERSHIP AGREEMENT; AND (III)&nbsp;THE
TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF THE SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT FOR PARTNERSHIP INTERESTS. THE PARTNERSHIP INTERESTS WILL NOT BE TRANSFERRED OF RECORD
EXCEPT IN COMPLIANCE WITH SUCH LAWS, THIS AMENDED AND RESTATED LIMITED PARTNERSHIP AGREEMENT, AND THE SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT. THEREFORE,
PURCHASERS OF SUCH INTERESTS WILL BE REQUIRED TO BEAR THE RISK OF THEIR INVESTMENT FOR AN INDEFINITE PERIOD OF TIME.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>AMENDED AND RESTATED LIMITED PARTNERSHIP AGREEMENT<BR>
OF<BR>
ANGEL OAK RESIDENTIAL EVERGREEN OPERATING PARTNERSHIP L.P.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">This
Amended and Restated Limited Partnership Agreement (as amended, modified, supplemented or restated from time to time, as the context
requires, this &ldquo;<U>Agreement</U>&rdquo;), dated as of [<FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT>], 2026, of </FONT>Angel Oak Residential Evergreen Operating Partnership
L.P., a Delaware limited partnership (the &ldquo;<U>Partnership</U>&rdquo;), is entered into by and among AO Residential Evergreen OP
GP, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, as the General Partner (as defined below), Angel Oak Residential Evergreen Trust, a Maryland
statutory trust, as a Limited Partner (as defined below) (the &ldquo;<U>Initial Limited Partner</U>&rdquo;), Angel Oak Residential Evergreen
Special Limited Partnership, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, as the Special Limited Partner (as defined below), and the Limited
Partners party hereto from time to time.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>RECITALS:</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">WHEREAS,
the </FONT>Partnership was formed on [<FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT>], 2026 as a limited partnership under the laws of the State of Delaware and a certificate
of limited partnership was filed with the Secretary of State of the State of Delaware (the &ldquo;<U>Certificate of Limited Partnership</U>&rdquo;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration
of the foregoing, of mutual covenants between the parties hereto, and of other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency
of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto agree as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>Article&nbsp;1</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B><U>DEFINED TERMS</U></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>1.1</B></FONT><B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Definitions</U></B>.
The following defined terms used in this Agreement shall have the meanings specified below:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Act</U>&rdquo;
means the Delaware Revised Uniform Limited Partnership Act, as it may be amended from time to time.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Additional Funds</U>&rdquo;
has the meaning set forth in <U>Section&nbsp;4.4</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Additional Securities</U>&rdquo;
means any additional REIT Shares (other than REIT Shares issued in connection with a redemption pursuant to <U>Section&nbsp;8.5</U>)
or rights, options, warrants or convertible or exchangeable securities containing the right to subscribe for or purchase REIT Shares,
as set forth in <U>Section&nbsp;4.3(a)(iii)</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Administrative
Expenses</U>&rdquo; means (i)&nbsp;all administrative and operating costs and expenses incurred by the Partnership and its Subsidiaries,
(ii)&nbsp;those administrative costs and expenses of the Initial Limited Partner, including any salaries or other payments to directors,
officers or employees of the Initial Limited Partner, and any accounting and legal expenses of the Initial Limited Partner, which expenses
are expenses of the Partnership and not the General Partner or Initial Limited Partner, and (iii)&nbsp;to the extent not included in
clause (ii)&nbsp;above, REIT Expenses.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 5; Options: NewSection; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->1<!-- Field: /Sequence --></P></DIV>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Affiliate</U>&rdquo;
means, with respect to any Person, (i)&nbsp;any Person directly or indirectly owning, controlling or holding with the power to vote 10%
or more of the outstanding voting securities of such other Person, (ii)&nbsp;any Person 10% or more of whose outstanding voting securities
are directly or indirectly owned, controlled or held, with the power to vote, by such other Person, (iii)&nbsp;any Person directly or
indirectly controlling, controlled by or under common control with such other Person, including any partnership in which such Person
is a general partner, (iv)&nbsp;any executive officer, director, trustee or general partner of such other Person, and (v)&nbsp;any legal
entity for which such Person acts as an executive officer, director, trustee or general partner; <U>provided</U>, that the Partnership,
the General Partner and the Initial Limited Partner shall not be deemed to be &ldquo;Affiliates&rdquo; of the Manager.</P>


<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Aggregate Share
Ownership Limit</U>&rdquo; shall have the meaning set forth in the Declaration of Trust.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Agreed Value</U>&rdquo;
means the fair market value of a Partner&rsquo;s non-cash Capital Contribution as of the date of contribution as determined by the General
Partner. The Agreed Value of any non-cash Capital Contributions by a Partner as of the date of contribution are set forth on the Partnership&rsquo;s
books and records.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Agreement</U>&rdquo;
has the meaning set forth in the Preamble.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Applicable Percentage</U>&rdquo;
has the meaning set forth in <U>Section&nbsp;8.5(b)</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Board of Trustees</U>&rdquo;
means the Board of Trustees of the Initial Limited Partner and any duly authorized committee of functional equivalent thereof.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Book-Up Adjustment</U>&rdquo;
has the meaning set forth in <U>Section&nbsp;5.2(c)</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Capital Account</U>&rdquo;
has the meaning set forth in <U>Section&nbsp;4.5</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Capital Contribution</U>&rdquo;
means the total amount of cash, cash equivalents or the Agreed Value of any property or other asset (other than cash or cash equivalents)
contributed or agreed to be contributed, as the context requires, to the Partnership by each Partner with respect to the interest held
by such Partner. Any reference to the Capital Contribution of a Partner shall include the Capital Contribution made by a predecessor
holder of the Partnership Interest of such Partner.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Carrying Value</U>&rdquo;
means, with respect to any asset of the Partnership, the asset&rsquo;s adjusted net basis for U.S. federal income tax purposes or, in
the case of any asset contributed to the Partnership, the Agreed Value of such asset, reduced by any amounts attributable to the inclusion
of liabilities in basis pursuant to Section&nbsp;752 of the Code, except that the Carrying Values of all assets may, at the discretion
of the General Partner, be adjusted to equal their respective fair market values (as determined by the General Partner), in accordance
with the rules&nbsp;set forth in Regulations Section&nbsp;1.704-1(b)(2)(iv)(f), as provided for in <U>Section&nbsp;4.5</U>. In the case
of any asset of the Partnership that has a Carrying Value that differs from its adjusted tax basis, the Carrying Value shall be adjusted
by the amount of depreciation, depletion and amortization calculated for purposes of the definition of Profit and Loss rather than the
amount of depreciation, depletion and amortization determined for federal income tax purposes.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Cash Amount</U>&rdquo;
means an amount of cash per Partnership Unit equal to the applicable Redemption Price determined by the General Partner.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Certificate</U>&rdquo;
means the Certificate of Limited Partnership and any other instrument or document that is required under the laws of the State of Delaware,
or any other jurisdiction in which the Partnership conducts business, to be signed and sworn to by any of the Partners of the Partnership
(either by themselves or pursuant to the power-of-attorney granted to the General Partner in <U>Section&nbsp;8.2</U>) and filed for recording
in the appropriate public offices within the State of Delaware or such other jurisdiction to perfect or maintain the Partnership as a
limited partnership, to effect the admission, withdrawal, or substitution of any Partner of the Partnership, or to protect the limited
liability of the Limited Partners as limited partners under the laws of the State of Delaware or such other jurisdiction.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Certificate of
Limited Partnership</U>&rdquo; has the meaning set forth in the Recitals.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Code</U>&rdquo;
means the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Commission</U>&rdquo;
means the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Common Share Ownership
Limit</U>&rdquo; shall have the meaning set forth in the Declaration of Trust.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Conversion Event</U>&rdquo;
shall have the meaning set forth in the Declaration of Trust.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Declaration of
Trust</U>&rdquo; means the Amended and Restated Declaration of Trust of the Initial Limited Partner effective as of [<FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT>], 2026, as
amended, modified, supplemented or restated from time to time.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>discretion</U>&rdquo;
means to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, a Person&rsquo;s entitlement to act in its &ldquo;sole and absolute&rdquo; discretion,
and to consider only such interests and factors as it, acting in a manner not constituting willful misconduct or gross negligence, considers
appropriate in the circumstances.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>DRIP</U>&rdquo;
shall have the meaning set forth in <U>Section&nbsp;5.8</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>DRIP Participant</U>&rdquo;
shall have the meaning set forth in <U>Section&nbsp;5.8</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Event of Bankruptcy</U>&rdquo;
as to any Person means the filing of a petition for relief as to such Person as debtor or bankrupt under the Bankruptcy Code of 1978
or similar provision of law of any jurisdiction (except if such petition is contested by such Person and has been dismissed within 90
days); insolvency or bankruptcy of such Person as finally determined by a court proceeding; filing by such Person of a petition or application
to accomplish the same or for the appointment of a receiver or a trustee for such Person or a substantial part of his, her or its assets;
commencement of any proceedings relating to such Person as a debtor under any other reorganization, arrangement, insolvency, adjustment
of debt or liquidation law of any jurisdiction, whether now in existence or hereinafter in effect, either by such Person or by another,
<U>provided</U> that if such proceeding is commenced by another, such Person indicates his, her or its approval of such proceeding, consents
thereto or acquiesces therein, or such proceeding is contested by such Person and has not been finally dismissed within 90 days.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Excess Profits</U>&rdquo;
shall have the meaning set forth in <U>Section&nbsp;5.2(c)(i)</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Exchanged REIT
Shares</U>&rdquo; shall have the meaning set forth in <U>Section&nbsp;6.9(b)</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&ldquo;<U>General
Partner</U>&rdquo; means </FONT>AO Residential Evergreen OP GP, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, and any Person who becomes
a substitute or additional General Partner as provided herein, and any of their successors as General Partner, in such Person&rsquo;s
capacity as a General Partner of the Partnership.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>General Partnership
Interest</U>&rdquo; means any Partnership Interest held by the General Partner, other than any Partnership Interest it holds in its capacity
as a Limited Partner.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>High Water Mark</U>&rdquo;
shall have the meaning set forth in the definition of &ldquo;<U>Loss Carryforward Amount</U>&rdquo; below.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&ldquo;<U>Hurdle
Amount</U>&rdquo; for any period during a calendar year means that amount that results in a 5.0% (8.0% in the case of the Series&nbsp;A-I
Units and the Series&nbsp;A-II Units) annualized internal rate of return on the Net Asset Value of the Performance Partnership Units
outstanding at the beginning of the then-current calendar year and all Performance Partnership Units issued since the beginning of the
then-current calendar year, taking into account the timing and amount of all distributions accrued or paid (without duplication) on all
such Performance Partnership Units and all issuances of Partnership Units over the period and calculated in accordance with recognized
industry practices. The ending Net Asset Value of the </FONT>Performance Partnership Units used in calculating the internal rate of return
will be calculated before giving effect to any allocation or accrual to the Performance Participation Interest and any applicable ongoing
servicing fee expenses; <U>provided</U> that the calculation of the Hurdle Amount for any period will exclude any Performance Partnership
Units redeemed during such period, which Performance Partnership Units will be subject to the Performance Participation Interest upon
such repurchase as described in <U>Section&nbsp;5.2(c)</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Indemnitee</U>&rdquo;
means (i)&nbsp;any Person made a party to a proceeding by reason of its status as the General Partner or a director, officer or employee
of the General Partner or the Partnership, (ii)&nbsp;the Manager, (iv)&nbsp;the Special Limited Partner, (v)&nbsp;the Partnership Representative
and (vi)&nbsp;such other Persons (including Affiliates of the General Partner, the Partnership, the Manager or the Special Limited Partner)
as the General Partner may designate from time to time, in its discretion.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Investments</U>&rdquo;
shall mean any investments by the Initial Limited Partner or the Partnership, directly or indirectly, in Real Property, Real Estate-Related
Assets or other assets.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Limited Partner</U>&rdquo;
means Angel Oak Residential Evergreen Trust, a Maryland statutory trust, in its capacity as a Limited Partner, and any other Person identified
as a Limited Partner on the Partnership&rsquo;s books and records, upon the execution and delivery by such Person of an additional limited
partner signature page, and any Person who becomes a Substitute Limited Partner, in such Person&rsquo;s capacity as a Limited Partner
in the Partnership.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->4<!-- Field: /Sequence --></P></DIV>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Limited Partnership
Interest</U>&rdquo; means the ownership interest of a Limited Partner in the Partnership at any particular time, including the right
of such Limited Partner to any and all benefits to which such Limited Partner may be entitled as provided in this Agreement and in the
Act, together with the obligations of such Limited Partner to comply with all the provisions of this Agreement and of the Act. A Limited
Partnership Interest may be expressed as a number of Partnership Units.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Loss</U>&rdquo;
has the meaning set forth in <U>Section&nbsp;5.1(e)</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Loss Carryforward
Amount</U>&rdquo; shall initially equal zero and shall cumulatively increase by the absolute value of any negative annual Total Return
and decrease by any positive annual Total Return, provided that the Loss Carryforward Amount shall at no time be less than zero and provided
further that the calculation of the Loss Carryforward Amount will exclude the Total Return related to any Performance Partnership Units
redeemed during such year, which units will be subject to the Performance Participation Interest upon redemption as described in <U>Section&nbsp;5.2(c)</U>.
The effect of the Loss Carryforward Amount is that the recoupment of past annual Total Return losses will offset the positive annual
Total Return for purposes of the calculation of the Special Limited Partner&rsquo;s performance participation allocation. This is referred
to as a &ldquo;<U>High Water Mark</U>.&rdquo;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Management Agreement</U>&rdquo;
means the agreement, as amended and/or restated from time to time, among the Initial Limited Partner, the Partnership and the Manager
pursuant to which the Manager will direct or perform the day-to-day business affairs of the Initial Limited Partner and the Partnership.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&ldquo;<U>Manager</U>&rdquo;
means Angel Oak Capital Advisors, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, or another Affiliate of </FONT>Angel Oak Companies, LP who
is appointed, employed or contracted with by the Initial Limited Partner and the Partnership and responsible for directing or performing
the day-to-day business affairs of the Initial Limited Partner and the Partnership, including any Person to whom the Manager subcontracts
all or substantially all of such functions.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Memorandum</U>&rdquo;
means the Confidential Private Placement Memorandum of the Initial Limited Partner with respect to the REIT Shares, dated as of [<FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT>],
2026, as may be amended or supplemented from time to time.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Mortgage</U>&rdquo;
shall mean, in connection with any mortgage financing that the Initial Limited Partner makes or invests in, all of the notes, deeds of
trust, security interests or other evidences of indebtedness or obligations, which are secured or collateralized by residential or commercial
Real Property, including, without limitation, (i)&nbsp;non-qualified loans, (ii)&nbsp;investor property mortgage loans (including debt
service coverage ratio or &ldquo;DSCR&rdquo; loans), (iii)&nbsp;agency-eligible mortgage loans, (iv)&nbsp;prime jumbo mortgage loans,
(v)&nbsp;home equity lines of credit, (vi)&nbsp;home equity sharing contracts, (vii)&nbsp;manufactured housing loans, (viii)&nbsp;non-performing
and re-performing mortgage loans, (ix)&nbsp;residential transitional loans, (x)&nbsp;reverse mortgage loans, (xi)&nbsp;commercial real
estate mortgage loans, and (xii)&nbsp;any other residential or commercial mortgage loans, in each case whether acquired from Affiliate
originators (including Angel Oak Mortgage Solutions, LLC and its affiliates) or from unaffiliated third-party mortgage companies and
other sellers.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Net Asset Value</U>&rdquo;
means (i)&nbsp;for any Partnership Units, the net asset value of such Partnership Units, determined in accordance with the valuation
guidelines that have been approved by the Board of Trustees and (ii)&nbsp;for any REIT Shares, the net asset value of such REIT Shares,
determined as of the last day of each month as described in the Memorandum.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

determined as of the last day of each month as described in the Memorandum.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Net Asset Value
Per Unit</U>&rdquo; means, for each Series&nbsp;of Partnership Units, the Net Asset Value per unit of such Series&nbsp;of Partnership
Units, determined as of the last day of each month as described in the Memorandum.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Notice of Redemption</U>&rdquo;

equal to the Partnership Minimum Gain that would result if such partner nonrecourse debt were treated as a nonrecourse liability (as
defined in Regulations Section&nbsp;1.752-1(a)(2)) determined in accordance with Regulations Section&nbsp;1.704-2(i)(3).</P>

Deductions</U>&rdquo; means &ldquo;partner nonrecourse deductions&rdquo; as set forth in Regulations Section&nbsp;1.704-2(i).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Partnership</U>&rdquo;
has the meaning set forth in the Preamble.</P>

means an ownership interest in the Partnership held by a Limited Partner, the General Partner or the Special Limited Partner and includes
any and all benefits to which the holder of such a Partnership Interest may be entitled as provided in this Agreement, together with
all obligations of such Person to comply with the terms and provisions of this Agreement.</P>

or the Partnership directly or indirectly through one or more of their Affiliates: (i)&nbsp;residential mortgage-backed securities (including
agency and non-agency RMBS); (ii)&nbsp;commercial mortgage-backed securities; (iii)&nbsp;collateralized mortgage obligations; (iv)&nbsp;commercial
and residential asset-backed securities; (v)&nbsp;credit risk transfer notes and synthetic credit risk transfer instruments; (vi)&nbsp;retained
interests (including subordinated, mezzanine, junior and interest-only tranches) in securitization transactions in which the Initial
Limited Partner or any Affiliate participates; (vii)&nbsp;structured credit instruments, including certificates issued by structured
investment vehicles that hold pools of mortgage loans or other real estate-related interests; (viii)&nbsp;mortgage derivatives, including
mortgage participations, total return swaps, credit default swaps, interest rate swaps, futures contracts, options, swaptions, caps,
floors, forward contracts and other derivative instruments utilized for investment or hedging purposes; (ix)&nbsp;equity interests in
entities owning Real Property or Mortgages (including real estate owned and equity real estate, whether residential or commercial); (x)&nbsp;consumer
loans; and (xi)&nbsp;any other real estate-related or mortgage-related security, note, instrument, certificate, participation or interest.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>REIT Expenses</U>&rdquo;
means (i)&nbsp;costs and expenses relating to the formation and continuity of existence and operation of the Initial Limited Partner
and any Subsidiaries thereof (which Subsidiaries shall, for purposes of this defined term, be included within the definition of Initial
Limited Partner), including taxes, fees and assessments associated therewith, any and all costs, expenses or fees payable to any director,
officer, or employee of the Initial Limited Partner or service providers to the Initial Limited Partner (including service providers
affiliated with the Manager), (ii)&nbsp;costs and expenses relating to any offering or registration of securities by the Initial Limited
Partner and all filings, statements, reports, fees and expenses incidental thereto, including all Organization and Offering Expenses,
(iii)&nbsp;costs and expenses incurred by the Initial Limited Partner relating to any issuance, repurchase or redemption of REIT Shares,
Partnership Interests or any other securities of the Initial Limited Partner, the Partnership or their respective Subsidiaries, (iv)&nbsp;costs
and expenses associated with the preparation and filing of any periodic or other reports and communications by the Initial Limited Partner
under federal, state or local laws or regulations, including filings with the Commission, (v)&nbsp;costs and expenses associated with
compliance by the Initial Limited Partner with laws, rules&nbsp;and regulations promulgated by any regulatory body, including the Commission
and any securities exchange, (vi)&nbsp;the management fee payable to the Manager under the Management Agreement and other fees and expenses
payable to other services providers of the Initial Limited Partner, (vii)&nbsp;operating and transaction costs and expenses attributable
to the Initial Limited Partner&rsquo;s or the Partnership&rsquo;s operations and investments, and (viii)&nbsp;all other operating and
administrative costs of the Initial Limited Partner incurred in the ordinary course of its business, including pursuant to the Management
Agreement.</P>

Shares having the same Series&nbsp;designation as the Series&nbsp;of Partnership Units offered for Redemption or exchange by a Tendering
Party; <U>provided</U> that in the event the Initial Limited Partner issues to all holders of REIT Shares rights, options, warrants or
convertible or exchangeable securities entitling the shareholders to subscribe for or purchase REIT Shares, or any other securities or

REIT Shares Amount shall also include the rights issuable to a holder of the REIT Shares Amount of REIT Shares on the record date fixed

be attributed to the first such Person under Code Section&nbsp;544 (as modified by Code Section&nbsp;856(h)(1)(B)).</P>

Act shall mean such provision as in effect from time to time, as the same may be amended, and any successor provision thereto, as interpreted
by any applicable regulations as in effect from time to time.</P>

Unit</U>&rdquo; means one Series&nbsp;A-I unit, which corresponds on a one-for-one basis to a Series&nbsp;A-I REIT Share of the Initial
Limited Partner.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Series&nbsp;B REIT
Shares</U>&rdquo; means the REIT Shares referred to as &ldquo;Series&nbsp;B Common Shares&rdquo; in the Declaration of Trust.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Series&nbsp;B Unit</U>&rdquo; means one Series&nbsp;B
unit, which corresponds on a one-for-one basis to a Series&nbsp;B REIT Share of the Initial Limited Partner.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Special Limited
Partner</U>&rdquo; means Angel Oak Residential Evergreen Special Limited Partnership, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, which
shall be a limited partner of the Partnership and recognized as such under applicable Delaware law, but not a &ldquo;Limited Partner&rdquo;
within the meaning of this Agreement (other than to the extent it owns Partnership Units).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Special Limited
Partnership Interest</U>&rdquo; means the interest of the Special Limited Partner in the Partnership representing solely its right as
the holder of an interest in distributions described in <U>Section&nbsp;5.2(c)</U>&nbsp;(and any corresponding allocations of income,
gain, loss and deduction under this Agreement), and not any interest in Partnership Units it may own from time to time.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Specified Redemption
Date</U>&rdquo; means upon receipt of timely Notice of Redemption pursuant to Section&nbsp;8.5(a), the same day of the quarter the Initial
Limited Partner repurchases REIT Shares from the holders of REIT Shares pursuant to the Initial Limited Partner&rsquo;s share repurchase
plan.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Subsidiary</U>&rdquo;
means, with respect to any Person, any corporation or other entity of which a majority of (i)&nbsp;the voting power of the voting equity
securities or (ii)&nbsp;the outstanding equity interests is owned, directly or indirectly, by such Person.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Substitute Limited
Partner</U>&rdquo; means any Person admitted to the Partnership as a Limited Partner pursuant to <U>Section&nbsp;9.3</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Successor Entity</U>&rdquo;
has the meaning set forth in <U>Section&nbsp;4.3(a)(ii)</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Survivor</U>&rdquo;
has the meaning set forth in <U>Section&nbsp;7.1(c)</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Tax Advances</U>&rdquo;
has the meaning set forth in <U>Section&nbsp;5.2(d)</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Tendered Units</U>&rdquo;
has the meaning set forth in <U>Section&nbsp;8.5(a)</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Tendering Party</U>&rdquo;
has the meaning set forth in <U>Section&nbsp;8.5(a)</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&ldquo;<U>Total
Return</U>&rdquo; </FONT>for any period since the end the of the prior calendar year shall equal the sum of (a)&nbsp;all distributions
accrued or paid (without duplication) on all of the Performance Partnership Units; and (b)&nbsp;the change in aggregate Net Asset Value
of the Performance Partnership Units since the beginning of the year, before giving effect to (x)&nbsp;changes resulting solely from
the proceeds of issuances Performance Partnership Units, (y)&nbsp;any Performance Participation Interest accrual and (z)&nbsp;applicable
shareholder servicing fee expenses (including any payments to the Initial Limited Partner for payment of such expenses). For the avoidance
of doubt, the calculation of Total Return will (i)&nbsp;include any appreciation or depreciation in the Net Asset Value of Performance
Partnership Units issued during the then-current calendar year but (ii)&nbsp;exclude the proceeds from the initial issuance of such Performance
Partnership Units.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Transaction</U>&rdquo;
has the meaning set forth in <U>Section&nbsp;7.1(b)</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Transfer</U>&rdquo;

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Trustee</U>&rdquo;

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Unit Equivalent</U>&rdquo;
means, on any given date, a REIT Share, or REIT Shares, or any portion of a REIT Share, of any given Series&nbsp;having the same Value
as the Net Asset Value of one Partnership Unit of the same Series&nbsp;on such date.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&ldquo;<U>Value</U>&rdquo;
means, for any Series&nbsp;of REIT Shares, the Net Asset Value Per REIT Share for REIT Shares of that Series.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>1.2</B></FONT><B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Interpretation</U></B>.
The definitions in <U>Section&nbsp;1.1</U> shall apply equally to both the singular and plural forms of the terms defined. Wherever the
context may require, any pronoun used in this Agreement shall include the corresponding masculine, feminine and neuter forms. For all
purposes of this Agreement: (a)&nbsp;the term &ldquo;control&rdquo; and variations thereof shall mean possession of the authority to
direct or cause the direction of the management and policies of the specified entity, through the direct or indirect ownership of equity
interests therein, by contract or otherwise; (b)&nbsp;&ldquo;either&rdquo; and &ldquo;or&rdquo; are not exclusive; (c)&nbsp;the words
&ldquo;include,&rdquo; &ldquo;includes&rdquo; and &ldquo;including&rdquo; shall be deemed to be followed by the phrase &ldquo;without
limitation&rdquo;; (d)&nbsp;the terms &ldquo;herein,&rdquo; &ldquo;hereof&rdquo; and &ldquo;hereunder&rdquo; shall refer to this Agreement
in its entirety; and (e)&nbsp;any references to &ldquo;Sections&rdquo; or &ldquo;Articles&rdquo; shall, unless otherwise specified, refer
to Sections or Articles, respectively, in this Agreement. Any references in this Agreement to an &ldquo;Exhibit&rdquo; shall, unless
otherwise specified, refer to an Exhibit&nbsp;attached to this Agreement, as such Exhibit&nbsp;may be amended from time to time. Each
such Exhibit&nbsp;shall be deemed incorporated in this Agreement in full.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center; background-color: white"><B>Article&nbsp;2</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center; background-color: white">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center; background-color: white"><B><U>PARTNERSHIP FORMATION
AND IDENTIFICATION</U></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>2.1</B></FONT><B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Formation</U></B>.
The Partnership was formed as a limited partnership pursuant to the Act and all other pertinent laws of the State of Delaware.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>2.2</B></FONT><B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Name,
Office and Registered Agent</U></B>. The name of the Partnership is Angel Oak Residential Evergreen Operating Partnership L.P. The specified
office and principal place of business of the Partnership shall be 980 Hammond Dr., Suite&nbsp;200, Atlanta, Georgia 30328. The General
Partner may at any time change the location of such office, provided the General Partner gives notice to the Partners of any such change.
The name and address of the Partnership&rsquo;s registered agent is c/o Corporation Service Company, 251 Little Falls Drive, City of
Wilmington, County of New Castle, Delaware 19808. The sole duty of the registered agent as such is to forward to the Partnership any
notice that is served on it as registered agent.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>2.3</B></FONT><B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Partners</U></B>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(a)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
General Partner of the Partnership is AO Residential Evergreen OP GP, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company. Its principal place
of business is the same as that of the Partnership.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->11<!-- Field: /Sequence --></P></DIV>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(b)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Limited Partners are Angel Oak Residential Evergreen Trust, a Maryland statutory trust (in its capacity as a Limited Partner), and any
other Persons identified as Limited Partners on the Partnership&rsquo;s books and records.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(c)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Special Limited Partner is Angel Oak Residential Evergreen Special Limited Partnership, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company. Its
principal place of business is the same as that of the Partnership.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>2.4</B></FONT><B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Term
and Dissolution</U></B>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(a)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Partnership commenced upon the filing for record of the Certificate of Limited Partnership in the office of the Secretary of State of
the State of Delaware, and shall continue indefinitely, except that the Partnership shall be dissolved upon the first to occur of any
of the following events:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(i)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>the
occurrence of an Event of Bankruptcy as to the General Partner or the dissolution, death, removal or withdrawal of the General Partner
unless the business of the Partnership is continued pursuant to <U>Section&nbsp;7.3(b)</U>;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(ii)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>the
passage of 90 days after the sale or other disposition of all or substantially all of the assets of the Partnership (<U>provided</U>
that if the Partnership receives an installment obligation as consideration for such sale or other disposition, the Partnership shall
continue, unless sooner dissolved under the provisions of this Agreement, until such time as such note or notes are paid in full); or</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(iii)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>the
election by the General Partner that the Partnership should be dissolved.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(b)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Upon
dissolution of the Partnership (unless the business of the Partnership is continued pursuant to <U>Section&nbsp;7.3(b)</U>), the General
Partner (or its trustee, receiver, successor or legal representative) shall amend or cancel any Certificate(s)&nbsp;and liquidate the
Partnership&rsquo;s assets and apply and distribute the proceeds thereof in accordance with <U>Section&nbsp;5.6</U>. Notwithstanding
the foregoing, the liquidating General Partner may either (i)&nbsp;defer liquidation of, or withhold from distribution for a reasonable
time, any assets of the Partnership (including those necessary to satisfy the Partnership&rsquo;s debts and obligations), or (ii)&nbsp;distribute
the assets to the Partners in kind.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>2.5</B></FONT><B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Filing
of Certificate and Perfection of Limited Partnership</U></B>. The General Partner shall execute, acknowledge, record and file at the
expense of the Partnership, any and all amendments to the Certificate(s)&nbsp;and all requisite fictitious name statements and notices
in such places and jurisdictions as may be necessary to cause the Partnership to be treated as a limited partnership under, and otherwise
to comply with, the laws of each state or other jurisdiction in which the Partnership conducts business.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>
